_comment: icons.js is a readable file whose bulk is one inline data: URI. The statement-density minified detector does NOT flag it (its long line is one literal, not packed code), so it stays authored code and the content scanners run on it - proved by reaching the debugger statement at icons.js:5. debugger-statement escalates rather than rejecting, so the GOLDEN is what pins that the file was scanned: the Extended Code Review hint naming icons.js:5 is the whole point of this fixture. If that line disappears, the long line is reading as minified again and the file is being skipped.
